text:
Fairleigh Dickinson University and Edcor announce tuition discount program for employees
A. M. Egan
Fairleigh Dickinson University announced on Aug. 26 a new partnership with Edcor Data Services to provide employees of participating Edcor client organizations with expanded access to affordable degree programs. Through this agreement, eligible employees will receive significant tuition discounts on select undergraduate and graduate programs offered by Fairleigh Dickinson University.
Jennifer Sipila, vice provost for Academic Affairs and executive director of Lifelong Learning at Fairleigh Dickinson University, said, "At Fairleigh Dickinson University, we are committed to making higher education accessible to working adults seeking to advance their careers. Our partnership with Edcor extends that commitment by providing employees across a broad range of organizations with a flexible and affordable pathway to earning an FDU degree."
The discounted tuition applies to several programs: Associate of Arts in Liberal Arts; Bachelor of Arts in Individualized Studies; Master of Administrative Science; Master of Public Administration; Master of Healthcare Administration; and Master of Science in Homeland Security Administration. These programs are intended to equip professionals with leadership, management, and analytical skills relevant for today's workplace.
Edcor is a third-party administrator specializing in employee education benefits for more than 45 years. The company works nationally with Fortune 1000 clients on services such as tuition assistance, academic advising, student loan repayment, scholarships, and other educational support.
Sara Van Wagoner, vice president of Corporate Growth at Edcor, said, “Pairing FDU’s superior academic quality with tuition savings translates to our client employees moving forward in their careers without taking on the financial stress that usually comes with going back to school, resulting in a win-win for all parties.”
Fairleigh Dickinson University is New Jersey’s largest private university system offering more than 100 degrees from associate through Ph.D., across multiple campuses including Florham Park and Teaneck in New Jersey as well as Vancouver. The New Jersey Business and Industry Association serves as the nation's largest statewide employer association representing employers across various sectors while advancing competitive excellence among its members through advocacy and partnerships among businesses, government entities, and academic institutions, according to the official website.
